title: 观光达人
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_003, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but controlled premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "观光达人" (sightseeing expert). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a beveled gold rim and glossy teal enamel center, more accomplished than tier 2. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase wearing oversized cheap black sunglasses and a ridiculously oversized tourist camera hanging in front of it, as if the suitcase has become a serious sightseeing influencer. Suitcase and camera are the only main elements. Add only two large star glints as lighting.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, silly but premium, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: simple large silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, camera large but not cluttered. No extra travel props.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, comedic over-serious luxury.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold, electric teal enamel, small coral accent only on rim, black sunglasses, black-and-gold camera, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, beveled rim, subtle hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
